description: Client-side script for product page interactions, including fetching product info, updating UI elements, handling cart actions, and variant selection.

methods.name: get_item_code
methods.description: Retrieves the current item code based on selected variants or default.

methods.name: find_closest_match
methods.description: Finds the closest matching variant item code based on selected attribute and value.

methods.name: get_selected_attributes
methods.description: Gathers all selected attribute values for the product variants.

methods.name: toggle_update_cart
methods.description: Toggles visibility of cart update UI elements based on quantity.
